categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of difficult-to-deform metal ring forgings for aerospace applications, especially for aircraft engines. Its products also serve aerospace rockets, missiles, marine gas turbines, industrial gas turbines, and energy equipment sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed proprietary technologies in material deformation and microstructure control for high-temperature alloys, titanium alloys, and aluminum alloys. It employs advanced ring rolling forging processes, digital simulation for process design, and integrated intelligent manufacturing systems. Key innovations include near-net-shape forming of complex large ring forgings and precise control of forging parameters to ensure product quality and performance.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include major domestic aerospace groups such as China Aviation Engine Group and AVIC, as well as leading international aircraft engine manufacturers like GE Aviation, Pratt & Whitney, Rolls-Royce, Safran, Honeywell, and Collins Aerospace. The company serves the commercial aircraft engine market, aerospace rocket engine market, gas turbine market, and energy equipment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates both domestically in China and internationally, with significant sales in the Asia-Pacific region and overseas markets including the United States and Europe. It has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Sichuan, Chongqing, Shanghai, Hong Kong, the British Virgin Islands, and the United States.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the aerospace supply chain, specializing in the manufacturing of high-precision ring forgings that are critical components for aircraft engines and other high-end equipment. It acts as a key supplier to engine manufacturers and integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding market share domestically and internationally, enhancing digital and intelligent manufacturing capabilities, and continuous R&D investment focused on new materials, advanced forging processes, and product quality improvement. The company emphasizes collaboration with research institutes and participation in national aerospace engine development programs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of customized aerospace ring forgings to engine manufacturers and related customers. The company operates on a build-to-order basis with long-term supply agreements and project-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: International competitors include established aerospace forging companies like Carlton Forge Works, Doncasters Group, and Howmet Aerospace. Domestically, the company is among the few qualified suppliers of high-performance aerospace ring forgings and holds a leading position in China with growing international recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 2.1 billion, a 44.69% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 185.58 million, a 1.21% increase. The company has shown steady growth in revenue and profitability, supported by increased orders and expanded production capacity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through advanced proprietary technologies enabling the production of high-quality, complex aerospace ring forgings with superior material properties and dimensional precision. Its integrated digital manufacturing and intelligent production lines enhance efficiency and product consistency, meeting stringent aerospace industry standards and customer requirements.
